coverageSpotVerification.detail: Mappings read in scripts/acceptance.mjs (the manifest is generated from assertions.json, so every suite-required ID is 'mapped' by construction; the tests were read one by one). Tautologies that cannot fail: m2-a13 assert(true); m2-a25 assert(own || true); m3-a11 assert(true); m4-a09 assert(msg?.editedAt || true); m5-a05 assert(true); m6-a08 assert(true) after reading the log; m6-a09 assert(true); m6-a11 assert(true); m8-a06 assert(true); m8-a07 assert(true). Tests that do not exercise the observable: m2-a11 asserts only that the Following payload is truthy; m2-a18, m2-a20 and m2-a26 assert only Array.isArray; m2-a12 checks the stored body contains 'https://' (not tappability); m2-a22/a23 assert page length <= 20 (not that a next page loads); m2-a27 checks the count is a number; m3-a15 replays only starter-m1 and compares inbox length; m5-a10/m5-a11 are API-only for UI search scopes; m8-a05 asserts Array.isArray. M1's tests are API-level proxies for UI observables (m1-a02, m1-a03/a04 'visible error', m1-a11 'renders') but do exercise the underlying behavior, so M1 is recorded as weak-but-honest (and m1-a03's UI observable independently fails). M6: three of five mapped tests are tautologies. Lane receipts: receipts/suite-m2.json carries no per-test results (a free-text note that M1 signups were skipped under E_RATE_LIMIT), and receipts/suite-status.json was overwritten by the last M8 run (m1-m6 pass:false). Divergence between suiteResult and independent result: m1-a03, m2-a17, m3-a11, m4-a01, m4-a03, m4-a06, m4-a07, m4-a09, m5-a04, m5-a10, m6-a11 (suite pass, grader fail). Each dishonest milestone adjudicates to capability-failure (scoring-only); O1 scores those checklists not-passed.

defects.summary: Clearing a repost leaves the repost row in every follower's Following feed (still present 75 s later, after the fan-out job ran), and the reposter can never repost that post again: the clear loop point-reads followers' feed rows the reposter cannot read (null, so nothing is deleted), and the re-repost's insert-if-absent then collides with a hidden row, refusing the whole mutation (repostCount stays 0).
defects.evidence: evidence/repost-recheck.json; evidence/api-probes.log m2-a17; snapback/schema.q:141-157 (feed read rule .readerId = viewer), :634-658 (setRepost); snapback4 README Rules ('collision with a row the writer cannot read returns the generic E_RULE, including insert-if-absent')

defects.summary: Web sign-up derives the handle from the email local part; when it collides with an existing handle the account is created and signed in with no profile and no visible error (profile write refused E_CONSTRAINT silently). Settings shows a bare '@', and the profile edit screen renders nothing because it requires an existing profile, so the account cannot recover.

defects.summary: createDm trusts caller-supplied pair keys: it only requires viewer to be a or b, not that {a, b} = {viewer, other}. A user can index the pair (self, E) onto a conversation with a third user B; E's later attempt to DM that user resolves to the poisoned channel, which E is not a member of (send refused NOT_MEMBER), while B is a member of the channel indexed as the D-E DM. Cross-user denial and misrouting through the custom-client API.

'At most one DM channel per user pair' is not enforced server-side: createDm with the same two principals in unsorted order creates a second DM channel (dmIndex unique key is ordered (a, b) and ordering is left to the client).

The web conversation stops syncing: the conversation view fires markDelivered and markRead for every message at 0, 0.4, 1.2 and 3 s on every change, which fills the durable outbox; the client's GET /sync?...&pending=[...] then fails (net::ERR_FAILED, surfaced as a CORS block), after which new messages, edits and deletes never render (the list goes stale or empty, even after reload). In a fresh DM live delivery works (~300 ms) until an edit+delete+reaction step, after which the recipient rendered 0 bubbles. Step diagnostic: [["open with 3 texts",false,true,3],["text added",true,true,4],["photo added",true,true,5],["video added",true,true,6],["view-once added",true,true,8],["edit+delete+reaction",true,true,0]].
defects.evidence: evidence/web-probes-2.log diag-open-conversation-live-update, diag-conversation-after-reload; evidence/web-convo-diag.json; screens/m4-m5-web-convo-affordances.png; receipts/choreo-m3.jsonl dm-live-messages, receipt-sent-delivered-read-transitions, group-receipt-waits-for-slowest-member

defects.summary: On web the conversation is replaced by a fixed full-screen DOM overlay (WebConvoSurface) that renders only text, quote preview, tombstone text and receipt: no photo/video rendering, no reaction, edit or delete controls, no 'edited' label, no view-once control, no sender avatars. Its attach button has no handler and the only file input is a 1x1 element covered by the overlay, so users cannot send media, react, edit, delete or open view-once photos on web; received media is invisible.

Production window and digest configuration is unreachable: the only config path seeds windows.shortened.json and digest.shortened.json through the dev-only POST /seed, schema fallbacks are the grading values (60 s edit, 120 s delete, 180/300 s disappearing, 120 s digest), and the digest schedule is hardcoded 'every 2m' with epoch-aligned periods (periodAnchorUtc ignored). A release (snapback4 serve refuses /seed) would ship grading windows and a 2-minute digest.

The history operation does not expose the M6 minimum field manifest: threadMessages has no message type field, no reaction aggregate (only the caller's myReaction) and no receipt state for the caller's own messages; API.md defers these to other queries and does not document inbox row fields or result ordering.

Post shape is not validated server-side: createPost accepts kind 'images' with a video clip attached, kind 'images' with no image, and kind 'text' carrying an image (brief: images 1-4, never mixed with video).
Quoted-reply preview labels the quoted sender 'Someone' in a DM between two members instead of the sender's display name.
defects.evidence: evidence/web-probes.log m3-a10-web ('Someone: jump origin message'); components/ConversationView.tsx:296-300

defects.summary: Platform-proof build artifacts are missing: dist/ios-m1 and dist/ios-m8 contain only clique-logo.png, video-poster.png and the device wasm, with no Hermes/JS bundle, and no exports exist for M2-M6.

Digest unreadMessages counts a message that was deleted-for-everyone in the same period (the accumulator is incremented at send and never decremented on tombstone or expiry). Observed {"expectedUnreadMessages":1,"U5":[{"newFollowers":0,"newPostsInFollowing":0,"unreadMessages":2,"unreadChats":1,"periodEndMinusStart":120000}]}.

A post created near the end of a digest period is attributed to that period by the minute-granular fan-out job, which can run after the period's digest was emitted, so the follower's newPostsInFollowing is lost. Observed {"postMsIntoPeriod":112006,"digestForThatPeriod":[],"digestNextPeriod":[]}.

The web conversation overlay is appended to document.body and never removed on unmount: after leaving a conversation through in-app navigation the overlay keeps covering the next screen. Observed {"overlayInConversation":true,"path":"/","overlayPresent":true,"overlayVisible":true,"overlayRect":[64,836],"feedItemRendered":true,"feedItemCoveredByOverlay":true,"overlayBubbleCount":1,"overlayPersists":true}.
